scoped_pass_notes: All nine assigned prose pairs have scoped semantic PASS. AGENTS.md was fully reread after refresh; the other eight retain the initial full-prose review, with mechanical-only finalization reported by the parent.

AGENTS.md now matches current source SHA 8be39a48cb372237173a0475e26eab192f9ce21f59f5e40a11e100e5e359b1b9. Both prior stale paragraphs and the source marker are synchronized; no new source-meaning omissions were found on the full pair reread.
Architecture preserves 60 Hz physics, 4 interactive catch-up steps, direct 30 Hz/reflections 10-20 Hz starting budgets, stale-result handling, and non-measured status.

Audio runtime preserves absolute propagation scheduling, 20 ms unvalidated fade target, pending-arrival replay exactly once, retarded-time versus quasi-static/Doppler caveats, bounded callbacks, and all NOT RUN status.
Data contracts preserve A+R+T=1, pressure/power conversion, the listener-to-penultimate-vertex arrivalDirection, absolute versus relative delay, contract limits, and distinct force/impulse units.

FPS and PhysicsAudioEvent preserve pause/Held/ghost policies, camera/listener separation, source-offset cross-product velocity, contact normal and closing-speed definitions, support versus impact distinction, deduplication, budgets, numeric defaults, and pending acceptance.
Acoustic/physics/performance validation retains synthetic/isolated evidence limits, mathematical tolerances, unit conventions, TARGET/UNVERIFIED/PROPOSED/PARTIAL and NOT RUN distinctions.

mechanical_support.code_fences: At the initial recorded semantic-review English versions, all seven fenced blocks were verbatim after line-ending normalization; Chinese comments were intentionally preserved. This is historical support, not a claim that finalized current files are byte-identical to those versions.
mechanical_support.numeric_literals: All numeric values/units were read in context. Exact numeric-token order differs harmlessly in PhysicsAudioEvent due to reordered wording/link placement, and in AcousticValidation due to room-mode order and numeric 0 becoming the English word Zero. No value change found.
mechanical_support.current_finalization: Fresh current English SHA-256 values for all nine pairs are recorded separately. AGENTS current finalized body was fully reread; the other eight finalization changes were not semantically reread and are reported by the parent as generated notices/anchors/relinked navigation only.

limits: This review covers only nine assigned pairs; it does not prove semantic accuracy of all 226 documents.

This is source-to-translation fidelity review, not validation of current product behavior or the truth/currentness of historical canonical statements. Historical pending and NOT RUN claims were preserved rather than updated.

The initial semantic review excluded raw source-relative link targets. The parent subsequently generated notices/anchors/relinked navigation. Only the full finalized AGENTS pair was reread; the other eight retain historical reviewed English hashes and separate fresh current hashes. Byte identity to historical English hashes is not claimed.

Parent-reported unchanged prose supports carrying forward the eight earlier scoped semantic reviews; this follow-up does not independently reverify those mechanical changes or cross-document link migration/resolution.
Fenced code/examples were intentionally kept verbatim including Chinese; their equality was checked in the initial semantic-review versions, not executed.
No browser, build, tests, external API/model calls, Git commands, or Wiki mutations were performed. Startup schema/index/now were read only to honor repository startup instructions.
Only docs/en/_reports/independent-physics.json and docs/en/_reports/independent-physics.md were written.
The first initial supporting PowerShell audit attempt hit a null-array formatting error; it was rerun with explicit empty arrays before results were interpreted.
